target_kind.description: internal: another service of this same system/architecture (e.g. a bare service name, an internal hostname or env var like PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL, a service-discovery/RPC client). external: a third-party vendor/SaaS (a vendor SDK import like stripe/twilio/boto3, a public vendor API domain, vendor-specific auth). unknown: can't tell from the evidence.

resource_type.description: Only when target_kind is 'external': what kind of resource it is (queue: SQS/SNS/pub-sub; storage: S3/blob storage; compute: a generic cloud API not fitting another bucket; saas: a third-party product like Stripe/Twilio; db_managed: a managed database/auth service like Firebase/DynamoDB; other: external but none of these fit). Use 'not_applicable' when target_kind is 'internal' or 'unknown'.
